facts.text: Deborah visited her mother's old house, which holds many memories for her.

evidence.quote: Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.
My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view.

facts.text: Deborah's mother passed away a few years ago, and the house is associated with their last photo together.

evidence.quote: It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together.

facts.text: Deborah sometimes sits on the special bench near the window in her mother's house to stay connected to her.

evidence.quote: I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.

facts.text: Jolene's mother also passed away last year, and she has many memories in her room in her mother's house.

evidence.quote: My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there.
